scripts.test: sh -c 'if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Skipping calibration-sandbox tests (Docker unavailable)"; else pnpm test:run; fi'
scripts.test:run: docker build -f functions/python/Dockerfile -t calibration-sandbox-test . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/var/task/tests:ro" -e PYTHONPATH=/var/task:/var/task/src/helpers --entrypoint python calibration-sandbox-test -m unittest discover -s /var/task/tests -v
